pages.text: The $(l)Dark Matter Shears$() and $(l)Red Matter Shears$() are the strange ones of the family. Craft the Dark Matter Shears from Dark Matter and a diamond, then upgrade them into the Red Matter Shears.$(br2)Press $(l)V$() to charge.$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)Right-click to shear every shearable mob around you; the radius grows with charge.$(li)Sheared drops are doubled.$(li)Each sheared mob has a 1% chance to spawn a random-colored baby clone of itself.$(li)Right-click leaves to clear all leaves in an area.$(li)Sheared sheep still give their wool normally.
